comparison.objective: Strip a decommissioned terminal rail while retaining earth blocks, versus remove HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective release and extraction of rail-mounted components rather than controlled impact fracture and recovery of released metal fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Unwanted terminal blocks removed and earth blocks retained; damage and completeness thresholds are absent. Candidate requires all four coils retained and tangs contained.
comparison.reason: There is superficial select-and-retain similarity, but rail-component disassembly does not test notch fracture, hammer control, or tiny-fragment containment.
